title: Agent 技能生态正在成型
opening: 今天榜单上最显眼的是 Agent 技能与插件的基础设施化：Cursor 发布官方插件规范，NVIDIA 推出技能评估框架，Google 则把 Stitch 的设计能力拆成技能包。另一个值得注意的信号是 HKUDS/CLI-Anything 已冲到近 6 万星，试图用 CLI 把任意软件改造成 Agent 可调用的接口。

projects.name: cursor/plugins
projects.description: Cursor plugin specification and official plugins
projects.readmeExcerpt: Cursor plugins Official Cursor plugins for popular developer tools, frameworks, and SaaS products. Each plugin is a standalone directory at the repository root with its own `.cursor-plugin/plugin.json` manifest. Plugins | `name` | Plugin | Author | Category | `description` (from marketplace) | | `teaching` | Teaching | Cursor | Utilities | Skill mapping, practice plans, and learning retrospectives. | | `continual-learning` | Continual Learning | Eric Zakariasson | Developer Tools | Incremental transcript-driven memory updates for AGENTS.md using high-signal bullet points only. | | `cursor-team-kit` | Cursor Team Kit | Eric Zakariasson | Developer Tools | Internal team workflows for CI, code review, shipping, local automation, and verification. | | `thermos` | Thermos | Cursor | Developer Tools | Thermo-nuclear branch review: deep security/correctness audits, harsh code-quality rubrics, parallel subagents, thermos orchestration, and optional merge-ready PR flows. | | `create-plugin` | Create Plugin | Cursor | Developer Tools | Scaffold and validate new agent plugins. | | `ralph-loop` | Ralph Loop | Cursor | Developer Tools | Iterative self-referential AI loops using the Ralph Wiggum
projects.summary: Cursor 官方插件规范与示例合集，每个插件独立目录并带 manifest，相当于给 Agent 扩展能力定了个标准抽屉。
projects.problem: 仓库里既有教学、持续学习这类通用技能，也有 Thermos 这种做深度安全审计和并行子代理的复杂插件。它更像规范样板而非开箱即用的市场，想直接拿来干活还得自己挑和配。

projects.summary: 给任意软件套一层 CLI，让 AI Agent 能像人一样敲命令操作 CAD、3D 场景、字幕等工具。

projects.summary: 一个 Agent 技能，并行搜索 Reddit、X、YouTube、HN、Polymarket 等平台，用点赞和真金白银的赔率而非编辑偏好来排序信息。

projects.name: NVIDIA/SkillEvaluator
projects.description: Multi-tier framework for evaluating AI agent skills and plugins with quality gates, security scanning, harness compatibility checks, semantic overlap detection, synthetic evaluation dataset generation, and live agent evaluation that measures how skills affect agent behavior. Ships reusable CI templates that bring every check to any repository.
projects.readmeExcerpt: Evaluate and improve AI agent skills and plugins: quality, security, overlap, compatibility, and real impact across agents > 📺 **Livestream:** Ask the Experts: Evaluating Agent Skills SkillEvaluator checks AI agent skills and plugins, and measures a skill's effect on task results: start with quality checks, then compare runs with and without a skill. Catch skill issues before merge. Connect your repository to SkillEvaluator with a CI template for automated quality and security gates, without building or maintaining evaluation code. Agent skills are folders of instructions and supporting files defined by the Agent Skills specification. SkillEvaluator is part of the NVIDIA Verified Skills pipeline. Get started Install the CLI in a Python 3.12–3.14 environment: Or use uv For uv setup or direct GitHub source installation, see Installation. Then check skills from your terminal, CI, or agent: Run checks backed by **500+ static rules and detection patterns**, without an LLM key. Complete scanner setup for full coverage: Run all three tiers After all-tier setup with NVIDIA Build, remove `--tiers 1` to add deduplication and live agent evaluation to measure skill lift: Check every skill cha
projects.summary: 给 Agent 技能做质检的多层框架：静态规则、安全扫描、语义重叠检测，再到真实 Agent 运行对比，一条龙卡在合并前。
projects.problem: 第一层靠 500 多条静态规则和检测模式，不需要 LLM key 就能跑；后两层才引入去重和实时 Agent 评估来量化技能带来的提升。它提供可复用的 CI 模板，适合想把技能质量门禁自动化的团队，但完整评估需要接 NVIDIA Build。

projects.summary: Rust 写的 Python 包和项目管理器，号称一个工具替代 pip、pip-tools、pipx、poetry、pyenv 等一串。
projects.problem: 亮点是 10 到 100 倍于 pip 的速度、通用锁文件、内联依赖脚本和 Cargo 风格 workspace。它已经不只是包安装器，而是在收拢整个 Python 项目工作流，对现有工具链的替代意图非常明显。

projects.name: google-research/paper-orchestra
projects.description: PaperOrchestra is a multi-agent framework for automated AI research paper writing.
projects.readmeExcerpt: 🎻 PaperOrchestra: A Multi-Agent Framework for Automated AI Research Paper Writing Yiwen Song 1 , Yale Song 1 , Tomas Pfister 1 , and Jinsung Yoon 1 1 Google Cloud AI Research PaperOrchestra is a multi-agent framework for automated AI research paper writing. It flexibly transforms unconstrained pre-writing materials (ideas and experimental logs) into submission-ready LaTeX manuscripts, including comprehensive literature synthesis and generated visuals, such as plots and conceptual diagrams. projects.summary: Google Research 的多 Agent 论文写作框架，把想法和实验日志变成带文献综述和图表的 LaTeX 投稿稿。
projects.problem: 流水线拆成大纲、文献综述、章节写作、内容精炼和绘图几个专职 Agent，覆盖从原始材料到成稿的完整链路。适合探索自动化写作的边界，但“投稿就绪”和实际学术质量之间还有很长的路。

projects.summary: Google Stitch 的 Agent 技能库，按开放标准拆成设计、构建、工具三组插件，可装进 Codex、Claude Code、Cursor 等。
projects.problem: 安装方式以插件市场为主，Codex 支持 CLI 和 UI 两种路径，Claude Code 和 Cursor 也有对应说明，但 OpenCode 需要手动安装。它把设计工具能力模块化，方便按需组合，不过目前更像配套生态而非独立产品。

projects.name: sveltejs/svelte
projects.description: web development for the rest of us
projects.readmeExcerpt: What is Svelte? Svelte is a new way to build web applications. It's a compiler that takes your declarative components and converts them into efficient JavaScript that surgically updates the DOM. Learn more at the Svelte website, or stop by the Discord chatroom. Supporting Svelte Svelte is an MIT-licensed open source project with its ongoing development made possible entirely by fantastic volunteers. If you'd like to support their efforts, please consider: - Becoming a backer on Open Collective. Funds donated via Open Collective will be used for compensating expenses related to Svelte's development such as hosting costs. If sufficient donations are received, funds may also be used to support Svelte's development more directly. Roadmap You may view our roadmap if you'd like to see what we're currently working on. Contributing Please see the Contributing Guide and the `svelte` package for information on contributing to Svelte. Is svelte.dev down? Probably not, but it's possible. If you can't seem to access any `.dev` sites, check out this SuperUser question and answer. License MIT
projects.summary: 把声明式组件编译成高效 JavaScript 的 UI 框架，靠编译期优化直接外科手术式更新 DOM。
projects.problem: 近 9 万星的老牌项目，README 保持极简，核心卖点仍是编译时消除运行时开销。在 Agent 技能刷屏的今天，它提醒人前端框架的竞争早已进入稳定期，拼的是生态和长期维护。

closing: 今天榜单的主线不是某个爆款应用，而是 Agent 技能从“能跑”走向“可评估、可分发、可组合”的基础设施层。值得留意的是，评估和规范类项目开始与技能本身同台竞争注意力。
